AgentCompass v0.7.5 makes a worker's completion notice reach its parent when the process that carries it has died, sends one notice per brief, and moves the repository to `akiiwa-games/AgentCompass-Router`.

- **The repository is now `akiiwa-games/AgentCompass-Router`.** Only the GitHub name and its URLs change: the package, the `agentcompass` command, the skill, the install directory and the environment variables keep their names. GitHub redirects the old address, so an installed v0.7.4 or earlier still finds its updates and its published data. New installs use `uv tool install "git+https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass-Router"` or the installer on the Releases page.
- **A notice whose watcher died is still delivered.** `roll` starts one watcher per dispatch that tells the parent when the worker finishes or needs a permission. On Windows, Antigravity runs each command in a job that ends its processes when the command returns (measured 2026-11-21), so a watcher started from an Antigravity session died with the `roll` and the parent waited until some session next made a router call. The Windows tray now looks after such dispatches: it runs a reconcile pass when a pass can change something (a watcher to restart, an ending the registry has not recorded, a failed attempt awaiting its fallback, a notice that can be sent now) and delivers within about a minute. It starts nothing while every watcher is alive, while a notice waits, or while the local Paseo daemon does not answer. Without the tray (a Python install, another OS) the next router call still catches up, as before.
- **One end notice per brief.** With automatic fallback on, a failed attempt could be announced as `State: error` and then relaunched, so one brief produced two terminal notices. The notice now waits until the fallback chain is final; a relaunched attempt is not announced on its own. A covered failure gets its fallback whichever reader recorded it first.
- **A notice whose send outcome is unknown is resolved, not retried for ever.** When Paseo answers that a send's outcome is unknown, the bridge looks for the notice in the parent's timeline: found is delivered; not found is sent again under a derived message id, no sooner than 15 minutes after the first send and 60 minutes after the second. After the third id the notice is recorded as undelivered, and the parent's own next router answer names it once (`undelivered_end_notices`).
- **A worker you continued.** When the same parent resumes a worker, the earlier turn's notice is recorded as continued once the later turn has landed, and the later turn's notice reports the work. The separate "took over" notice is removed. A resume that failed or never landed leaves the earlier notice to be sent with its own reply.
- **Fixed in dispatch.** A `roll` that resumes a worker Paseo no longer lists keeps its claim while another session reconciles; before, the claim could be canceled and a worker created with no reservation. A worker removed from Paseo leaves a notice for its parent. A turn that ended on its reply is read as replied when a tool call it had started closed late.
- **Hosted Services, without Gemini Web.** The tray's Integrations page is now **Hosted Services** (托盘托管): the local services the tray installs, starts, stops and keeps updated, and the page lists the ones supported today (Usage Float, ChatGPT Web, EasyTier, Dot2API, Grok Bot CLI, Muse2API). Gemini Web is no longer among them: its card and tray line, the `gemini-web` skill and its port setting are removed. Nothing of yours is deleted: the clone under `~/.agent-compass/plugins/gemini-web` and its signed-in Chrome profile stay where they are, and [gemini-web](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/gemini-web) still runs on its own. The update applies your earlier setup again, and that run removes the skill links AgentCompass had made for it.
- **Installer.** The logon task that starts the tray was registered with Task Scheduler's default 72 hour execution limit, so a tray started at logon was stopped after three days. The installer now registers the task through the product's own registration (no limit, normal priority, a 20 second delay after logon). Updating to this version replaces the task.

Answers that changed: `notify_end` can answer `fallback_pending` and `notice_resend_wait`; `end_notice.source` in the dispatch registry gains `relaunched`, `continued`, `watcher_found`, `watcher_resent`, `catchup_found`, `catchup_resent`, `watcher_undelivered` and `catchup_undelivered`; `plan --format table` names no undelivered notice (the JSON answer does).

Not verified: the tray's pass was run against a stand-in Paseo host and real watcher processes, not against a live Antigravity session after this build. A watcher that is alive but stalled is not recovered by the pass. An installer that fails to register the logon task does not say so; it starts the tray once directly. The boards were not read again for this release: scores are those of the 2026-11-18 snapshot plus what was published since.

The Windows tray installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. See [packaging/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass-Router/blob/v0.7.5/packaging/SIGNING.md).

Status: alpha. Accounts come from discovery on your machine; choose which ones take part in the tray.
